mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_inquiry(ingredient_name, unit, price, source, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{ingredientName}, #{unit}, #{price}, #{source}, NOW(), NOW(), #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT i.name FROM ingredient i JOIN ingredient_category c ON i.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name LIKE '%蔬菜%' ORDER BY i.name

SELECT t.ingredient_name AS ingredientName, t.unit AS unit, MAX(CASE WHEN t.source = '楚小兔' THEN t.price END) AS priceChu, MAX(CASE WHEN t.source = '泰康永乐' THEN t.price END) AS priceTai, MAX(CASE WHEN t.source = '云仓电商' THEN t.price END) AS priceYun FROM ( SELECT m.* FROM market_inquiry m JOIN ( SELECT ingredient_name, source, MAX(id) AS mid FROM market_inquiry GROUP BY ingredient_name, source ) x ON m.id = x.mid ) t
AND t.ingredient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY t.ingredient_name, t.unit ORDER BY t.ingredient_name

SELECT i.id AS ingredientId, i.name AS ingredientName, s.name AS supplierName, i.price AS price, i.price_unit AS priceUnit, i.weight_per_unit AS weightPerUnit, i.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.avgPrice AS avgPrice, m.maxPrice AS maxPrice, m.minPrice AS minPrice, m.quoteCount AS quoteCount FROM ingredient i LEFT JOIN supplier s ON i.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.ingredient_name AS nm, AVG(t.price) AS avgPrice, MAX(t.price) AS maxPrice, MIN(t.price) AS minPrice, COUNT(*) AS quoteCount FROM ( SELECT m0.* FROM market_inquiry m0 JOIN ( SELECT ingredient_name, source, MAX(id) AS mid FROM market_inquiry GROUP BY ingredient_name, source ) x ON m0.id = x.mid ) t GROUP BY t.ingredient_name ) m ON m.nm = i.name WHERE i.category_id = 13
AND i.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY i.name, i.id
